knowBeforeStarting: GATE-CLI/GATE-DESKTOP ya pasaron: NO romper la paridad golden (22/14/8), la matriz CLI ni los tests del desktop; cualquier cambio de comportamiento se adjudica con fixture + razón (regla de ejecución 5).

scope.primaryGoal: Lint exported legacy GeneXus source with trustworthy, traceable diagnostics from a Rust CLI before exposing the same engine through a Tauri 2 desktop application.

targetStack.desktop: Tauri 2 with Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS

deferred: An eframe/egui implementation; replace the old GUI direction with Tauri 2.
Direct inspection of a live GeneXus knowledge base unless an export or supported adapter is explicitly provided.
PDF as a prerequisite for the first functional CLI release.

verified: cargo test --workspace passes 10 tests; no engine or rule integration tests run.
gx --file accepts an argument but prints a scaffold message without linting.
The GUI and gx_report are scaffolds; no Vue frontend exists.
The workspace contains 30 rule types, including 24 concrete rules and six abstract grouping rules.
baselineEvidence.qualification: Compilation and small unit tests do not establish detection accuracy, Python parity, or production readiness.

priorityModel.P0: Correctness or observability blocker; required before claiming a working engine.
priorityModel.P1: Required for the first operational CLI and legacy export support.
priorityModel.P2: Required for the Tauri desktop release after the CLI gate passes.
priorityModel.P3: Post-CLI enhancement that must not block basic linting.

executionRules: Implement stories in dependency order. Do not start desktop integration before GATE-CLI passes.
Keep the Rust engine independent of clap, Tauri, Vue, and PDF generation.
Add regression tests that demonstrate a reported defect before changing dispatch, rule state, or source mapping.
Return explicit errors for unreadable or unsupported input; never represent a failed scan as a clean result.
Treat Python output as a compatibility baseline, then adjudicate any differences caused by a demonstrable Python defect.
Preserve user configuration and existing audit history during migrations and reseeding.
Do not claim full legacy-version coverage until representative exports and expected results have been supplied and verified.

milestones.name: Reliable library engine for supported exports

stories.title: Make the golden source reproducible
agentActions: Locate or add a committed, redistributable GeneXus source fixture corresponding to golden_issues.json; record its SHA-256 and provenance.
Document the Python baseline version, enabled rule set, and deterministic comparison fields.
Avoid depending on a sibling repository or local virtual environment for routine Rust tests.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean checkout contains everything needed to run the Rust parity test.
The fixture-to-golden relationship is machine checked and no generated PDF path or timing is compared.

stories.title: Build end-to-end engine and rule regression tests
agentActions: Run the public engine entry point against the golden fixture and compare rule ID, severity, source location, and stable diagnostic text.
Add minimal positive and negative fixtures for every concrete rule, emphasizing state transitions and nested blocks.
Test repeated scans, different files, enabled-rule filtering, deterministic output ordering, and zero-finding files.
acceptanceCriteria: The suite fails against the documented dispatch and reset defects and passes after they are corrected.
All 24 concrete rules are exercised by at least one behavior-level test.

stories.title: Reset every rule for every source object
agentActions: Call Rule::reset with the actual source path before evaluating any line or finalizing each object.
Ensure sequential and parallel entry points share the same lifecycle contract.
Verify diagnostics always carry the real file path and that state never leaks across scans.
acceptanceCriteria: Running one rule instance on A then B produces the same diagnostics for B as a fresh instance.
No emitted issue uses the placeholder path Unknown.

stories.title: Replace unsafe line-trigger dispatch for stateful rules
agentActions: Specify each rule's required start, continuation, body, and closing events; select a dispatch strategy that delivers all of them.
Cover For Each/Where/Defined By/EndFor, Case/Otherwise/EndCase, Sub/body/EndSub, comments, and multiline parm blocks.
Retain a simple all-lines route for rules whose state cannot be safely described by isolated tokens.
Remove the current fallback assumption that a nonempty candidate set implies all relevant rules were selected.
acceptanceCriteria: A WHERE continuation without the word where is examined by active WHERE rules.
GX.1.3 receives where, defined by, and endfor; GX.2.6 receives nullvalue assignments; GX.1.3.3 receives otherwise.
Dispatch results match an all-rules-per-line reference implementation on the regression corpus.

stories.title: Make scans deterministic and error transparent
agentActions: Sort candidate evaluation and final diagnostics by a documented stable key while preserving meaningful source order.
Change parallel evaluation to return per-file success or a contextual error, never an empty success on failure.
Define behavior for a missing file, invalid XPZ, encoding failure, and per-file partial failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeated and parallel scans produce identical ordered diagnostics.
A corrupt input causes a visible non-success result and cannot pass a quality gate as zero findings.

stories.title: Model source objects and preserve original locations
agentActions: Replace XPZ member concatenation as the diagnostic coordinate system with a source-object model containing container path, member/object identity, section, original line, and text.
Evaluate each XPZ object independently so rule state and generated-subroutine boundaries do not cross objects.
Expose a stable source reference usable by CLI JSON and a desktop code viewer.
acceptanceCriteria: A finding in the second XPZ member points to that member's original line rather than a synthetic concatenated line.
The same object exported as XML and inside XPZ yields equivalent rule findings.

stories.title: Harden export discovery, decoding, and XPZ parsing
agentActions: Include .xml in explicit source discovery and reject unrelated files rather than linting arbitrary fallback files.
Test UTF-8 with and without BOM, Windows-1252 and other confirmed legacy encodings against actual exports.
Validate ZIP members and XML Events extraction; bound archive size, member count, and expanded bytes.
Replace raw-XML fallback with an explicit unsupported-layout diagnostic unless a documented source-bearing section can be extracted.

POST-M2 (2026-10-02): detectar contenedor por magic bytes (ZIP o RAR; GeneXus empaqueta con WinRAR) y aceptar .zip explícito por contenido; build.rs de linkeo advapi32/crypt32 para unrar_sys; parser ExportFile/GXObject (identidad Info/Name+Info/Folder, código Events+Rules+Subroutines, excluir Documentation/Layout/Help/Structure).
POST-M2: contrato sin código refinado: objetos GeneXus reconocidos sin secciones de código = PASS con 0 hallazgos + warning a stderr; solo un layout sin GXObject ni Events es 'no soportado'.
acceptanceCriteria: Supported extensions and encodings are documented and tested.

An XPZ without usable source is reported as unsupported, never silently linted as XML markup. Los exports con objetos reconocidos sin código escanean como PASS 0 con aviso (nunca como error ni como linteo de markup).
Exports reales (ZIP y RAR) fijan snapshot adjudicado en tests/fixtures/real_exports/manifest.json (hash + conteos + spot-checks verificados contra la fuente).

stories.title: Validate legacy dialects and rule semantics
agentActions: Collect representative exports and expected findings for each target GeneXus version and object type.
Audit all 24 concrete rules for syntax variants, nested scopes, comments, string literals, and false positives.
Specifically verify hardcoded-string checks after ParsedLine removes literals and verify cases with multiline comments and expressions.
Record any intentional policy difference from the Python implementation as an explicit regression decision.

POST-M2 (2026-10-02): exports reales recolectados (4: WebPanel/Procedure/Transaction; ZIP y RAR) con spot-checks verificados manualmente (Sub sin nullvalue, OR en Where, hardcodes, If sin Else, Parm sin direcciones) y snapshot en tests/fixtures/real_exports/manifest.json. Exclusión documentada: variantes de export de otras versiones GX (p.ej. GX16/Evo) hasta contar con muestras.
acceptanceCriteria: A version/object support matrix names verified fixtures and known exclusions.
Every accepted rule difference is reviewed with an input example and expected output.
La matriz de exports reales vive en tests/fixtures/BASELINE.md (contenedores, secciones lintadas/excluidas, contrato sin código) y el snapshot real fija los conteos por regla.

stories.title: Initialize a complete and trustworthy rule catalog
agentActions: Make first-run initialization populate all expected rule metadata and the intended 15-rule default enabled set.
Make CSV reseeding idempotent and preserve user enabled flags; validate catalog IDs against the compiled registry.
Propagate SQL/configuration failures instead of interpreting them as enabled rules.
Resolve the current zero-rule migration state and verify seeding is actually invoked by the application.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh database has 24 concrete rule records and the expected enabled count.
A second startup changes no enabled flags; a corrupt database yields an error rather than a silent all-rules scan.

stories.title: Separate analysis policy from persistence and define quality gates
agentActions: Introduce a serializable AnalysisRequest and AnalysisResult with explicit enabled rules, input list, metrics, diagnostics, warnings, and scan failures.
Keep the engine callable with an in-memory rule configuration for deterministic tests and a read-only mode.
Implement named quality-gate policies: CLI absolute error/warning thresholds and the legacy GUI percentage policy; record which policy produced a verdict.
Define whether scan errors always fail the quality gate and how zero findings are scored.
acceptanceCriteria: The same request yields the same findings with or without SQLite history enabled.
CLI and percentage policy tests cover pass, reject, zero findings, and scan errors.

stories.title: Persist audit runs atomically and expose history
agentActions: Store run metadata, object-aware issue locations, metrics, policy, verdict, and failures in one transaction.
Version schema changes and test migration from an existing database without deleting user data.
Keep history optional for CI/read-only CLI use.
acceptanceCriteria: A failed issue insert rolls back the complete run.
Historical issues retain enough source identity to reopen the correct XPZ member.

stories.title: Implement gx scan and rule-management commands
agentActions: Replace the scaffold with scan of one file or a directory, recursive discovery, explicit include/exclude filters, and selected rule profiles.
Retain --file, --max-errors, and --max-warnings compatibility where practical; provide --help, version, list-rules, and rule enable/disable operations.
Print a concise human summary with source-aware diagnostics and quality-gate outcome.
Use documented exit codes for pass, policy rejection, invalid invocation, and scan/infrastructure failure.
acceptanceCriteria: gx --file <fixture> analyzes the file and returns actual findings rather than a scaffold message.
A missing path exits nonzero with a useful stderr message; --help is accurate.

stories.title: Add machine-readable CLI output and deterministic CI behavior
agentActions: Implement --format text|json with a versioned JSON schema and stable diagnostic ordering.
Keep stdout valid JSON in JSON mode; send progress and operational errors to stderr.
Expose input provenance, source object, line, rule, severity, metrics, policy, verdict, and scan failures.
Document an optional no-history mode and avoid unrequested writes during CI scans.
acceptanceCriteria: JSON mode parses as one complete document on pass and policy rejection.
Snapshot tests cover stdout, stderr, and exit codes on Windows.

stories.title: Run a CLI acceptance matrix on real exports
agentActions: Exercise text, XML, XPZ, multi-object XPZ, directory, clean file, malformed input, encoding variants, and quality-gate rejection through the compiled gx binary.
Compare the golden fixture and adjudicated legacy corpus against expected findings.
Run fmt, clippy, tests, and release build in CI; record CLI commands and sample outputs in the README.
acceptanceCriteria: GATE-CLI passes on a clean checkout without Python or the sibling repository.
No supported input failure is reported as a clean scan.

stories.title: Create the Tauri 2, Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind shell

handoffSpec.objective: Shell Tauri 2 arrancable en Windows con frontend Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind, vinculado a las crates existentes, sin tocar el CLI.
steps: Crear directorio `desktop/` con proyecto Tauri 2: usar `npm create tauri-app@latest` (template vue-ts) o estructura manual: package.json (vue 3.5, vite 6, typescript 5, @vitejs/plugin-vue, tailwindcss 4, @tauri-apps/api 2, @tauri-apps/cli 2), vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, tailwind config, src/ (main.ts, App.vue, router opcional).

Configurar `desktop/src-tauri/`: Cargo.toml del app (tauri 2 con features default, tauri-build), tauri.conf.json (productName 'gx-linter', identifier 'com.gx.linter', ventana por defecto 1280x800, devUrl http://localhost:5173, frontendDist ../dist), capabilities mínimas (core:default + dialogs:allow-open si se usa dialog nativo).
Integrar las crates existentes como dependencias path: desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml → gx_core, gx_engine, gx_storage (path = '../../crates/...'). NO agregar dependencia a clap.

Crear workspace separado para el app desktop (desktop/src-tauri tiene su propio Cargo.toml como workspace raíz de esa carpeta) para NO acoplar el workspace principal del engine al toolchain frontend; alternativa aceptada: agregar como member del workspace principal si no rompe `cargo test --workspace`.
Eliminar el scaffold egui: borrar `crates/gx_app/src/main.rs` (bin gx_linter_gui) y su [[bin]] de crates/gx_app/Cargo.toml; actualizar README/PROGRESS que aún mencionan eframe/egui.
Definir comandos: dev = `npm run tauri dev`, build = `npm run tauri build`; documentarlos en README (sección Desktop).

Vista inicial Vue mínima: App.vue con layout Tailwind + componente placeholder 'Scan' que llame (por ahora stub) al comando ping definido en Rust (invoke_handler con #[tauri::command] fn ping() -> String).
risks: Tauri 2 requiere Rust stable reciente y WebView2 en Windows (preinstalado en Win10/11 recientes); documentar prerequisito.
MSVC toolchain necesario para el build del shell Rust.

agentActions: Add a Tauri 2 shell linked to existing Rust crates and a Vue 3 frontend using TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
Remove the unused egui scaffold from the delivered GUI path and update documentation that still selects egui.
Define development and production commands, window defaults, and minimal Tauri capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: The desktop app starts and renders a Vue view on Windows.
The gx CLI still builds and runs independently of the frontend toolchain.
cargo test --workspace sigue en verde (el workspace del engine no depende del toolchain frontend).

stories.title: Expose safe asynchronous Rust commands to the frontend

handoffSpec.objective: Capa de comandos Tauri async segura y tipada que REUTILICE el contrato AnalysisRequest/AnalysisResult existente.
commands: scan(request: AnalysisRequest, on_progress: tauri::ipc::Channel<ScanProgressEvent>) -> AnalysisResult — ejecutar en spawn_blocking (rayon ya paraleliza internamente vía analyze()); emitir progreso por archivo con per-file status (pendiente/ok/fallo) usando tauri Channel; soportar cancelación con AtomicBool compartido (chequeo en evaluate_files_parallel_with_ctx o envolver por archivo).
pick_source_files() -> Vec<PathBuf> — diálogo nativo (plugin dialog); validar extensiones en Rust (la misma lista SOURCE_EXTENSIONS de gx_core::filesystem).
list_rules(rules_csv: Option<String>) -> Vec<RuleRecord> — vía gx_storage::dao::rules_dao::get_all (concrete only como el CLI) o import_reglas_csv en memoria.
set_rule_enabled(id: String, enabled: bool) — gx_storage (base local del usuario; misma init_db que el CLI).
list_audit_runs(limit) / get_audit_issues(run_id) — audit_dao::list_runs / get_issues_for_run (reconstruye ObjectRef → el visor puede abrir el miembro correcto).
render_text_summary(result: AnalysisResult) -> String — reutilizar el formato del CLI (extraer la función print_text_summary a gx_core o duplicarla conscientemente; decisión documentada).
types: Serializar TODOS los tipos del contrato con serde (ya derivan Serialize/Deserialize: AnalysisRequest/Result, Issue, ObjectRef, QgPolicy, QgVerdict, ScanFailure, AuditMetrics).
Generar tipos TypeScript espejo manualmente en desktop/src/api/types.ts (o con ts-rs/specta si se decide; opción simple: mirror manual con test de deserialización cruzada).
boundary: Validar paths en el comando Rust (no confiar en el frontend): rechazar rutas inexistentes con error estructurado {code, message} — nunca panic.
Los errores Rust → Result<T, CommandError> con thiserror; el frontend mapea message a UI.
NO duplicar lint logic en TypeScript: el frontend sólo construye AnalysisRequest y muestra AnalysisResult.
tests: Test de paridad CLI↔desktop a nivel de Rust: mismo AnalysisRequest → mismo AnalysisResult (ya cubierto por analyze_contract::same_request_same_result_with_or_without_history; agregar un test que ejecute analyze() y afirme idéntico resultado con el set del GUI).
Test del comando scan con Channel capturando eventos de progreso (tauri::test feature).

agentActions: Expose typed commands for file selection, scan start/cancel, rule catalog/configuration, settings, and audit history.
Execute CPU-bound scans away from the UI thread and emit progress with per-file status.
Validate paths and payloads at the Rust boundary; return structured errors with actionable messages.
Use the same AnalysisRequest and AnalysisResult contract as the CLI; do not duplicate lint logic in TypeScript.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI remains responsive during a directory scan and displays failures per file.
A CLI and desktop scan with identical request and rule set produce identical findings.
Los errores del comando llegan al frontend como mensajes estructurados, no panic/500.

stories.title: Build the audit workflow and source-aware results UI

handoffSpec.objective: UI completa de auditoría source-aware, con reglas, historial y estados accesibles.
views: ScanView: selector de archivo/directorio (comando pick_source_files o input manual), opciones del scan (política: absolute max_errors/max_warnings vs percentage; --enable/--disable → enabled_rule_ids del AnalysisRequest), botón Iniciar/Cancelar, barra de progreso con eventos Channel.

ResultsView: métricas (total/errors/warnings/info), veredicto con política, badge prominente para failures (nunca mostrar como limpio), tabla de hallazgos filtrable por regla/severidad/objeto (los Issue ya traen object ObjectRef), orden estable.

SourceViewer: al clic en un hallazgo, obtener el texto del SourceObject (comando read_object_source(container_path, member) en Rust usando extract_source_objects) y anclar a line_number real (miembro-local); navegación anterior/siguiente hallazgo; resaltado de la línea.
RulesView: catálogo (24 concretas) con toggle enable/disable → set_rule_enabled; indicador del set efectivo; rerun del audit sin reiniciar la app.
HistoryView: list_runs + get_issues_for_run → misma ResultsView reutilizada (datos históricos conservan ObjectRef).
handoffSpec.store: Pinia (o composables simples) para estado del scan en curso, resultados y configuración; mantener TypeScript estricto.
ux: Estados de carga y vacíos; skeleton en la tabla para resultados grandes (virtualizar si > 1000 filas con vue-virtual-scroller o similar).
Atajos de teclado (j/k o flechas para navegar hallazgos, Enter para abrir en visor), focus visible, labels accesibles (aria), contraste AA.
Errores por archivo visibles en la barra de progreso y en un panel de 'Fallos de scan' separado de los hallazgos.
handoffSpec.fixturesDePrueba: usar tests/fixtures/sources/sample_package.xpz (ProcMalo con 2 hallazgos miembro-local, ProcBueno limpio) y ejemplo_codigo.txt (22 hallazgos) como datos de desarrollo del visor.

agentActions: Implement input selection, scan options, progress, metrics, gate status, filterable diagnostics, and a source viewer anchored to object and original line.
Show unsupported inputs and partial failures prominently; never display them as a clean result.
Add rule configuration and history views backed by the command layer.
Make keyboard navigation, focus states, accessible labels, loading states, and large-result rendering part of the implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can inspect a finding inside the correct XPZ member and navigate to its original line.
The interface can configure rules and rerun an audit without restarting.
Un scan con archivo corrupto muestra el fallo destacado, nunca un resultado limpio.

stories.title: Validate and package the desktop release

handoffSpec.objective: Release validado e instalador Windows, con datos de usuario preservados.
steps: tauri.conf.json: bundle targets NSIS (installer) para Windows; iconos generados con `npm run tauri icon`.
Verificar assets embebidos: el binario Rust incluye el dist de Vue en producción (frontendDist); el app NO necesita Node en runtime.
Workflow CI: job desktop (windows-latest, si se aprueba costo) que instala Node 20, `npm ci`, `npm run tauri build`, sube el artefacto NSIS; los jobs del CLI/engine ya existen y NO dependen de Node.

Pruebas de upgrade: abrir la base local de una instalación previa (gx_storage::db::init_db hace migraciones V1→V3 sin borrar datos; ya cubierto por tests de migración) y validar que reglas y historial sobreviven.
README: sección Desktop con prerequisitos (WebView2, MSVC), ubicación de datos (%APPDATA%/GX/Linter/gx_linter.db), y troubleshooting (WebView2 faltante, WebView bloqueado por políticas).
checks: Lista de verificación manual del flujo: seleccionar archivo → scan → ver hallazgos → abrir miembro XPZ → configurar regla → rerun → history.
Verificar que el instalador corre con el antivirus defensor de Windows sin falsos positivos graves (si ocurre, documentar firma pendiente).

agentActions: Run desktop integration and visual workflow checks on representative legacy exports.
Build a Windows installer and verify bundled assets, migrations, rule catalog, file dialogs, and upgrade behavior.
Document installation prerequisites, local data locations, and a troubleshooting path.
acceptanceCriteria: GATE-DESKTOP passes from a clean build and installed package.
Installation and upgrade preserve rule preferences and audit history.

stories.title: Implement PDF export on top of the shared result model

handoffSpec.objective: PDF source-aware generado desde AnalysisResult SIN re-ejecutar el engine.
steps: Elegir generador: `printpdf` (puro Rust, control bajo) o `typst`/`wkhtmltopdf` externo — recomendado printpdf por dependencia mínima; abstraer detrás de `gx_report::render(result: &AnalysisResult, out_path: &Path) -> Result<()>`.
Contenido: portada con métricas/veredicto/política + tabla paginada de hallazgos (regla, severidad, objeto id/member, línea real, descripción); envolver texto Unicode largo con paginación manual.
CLI: `gx export-pdf --result-file <json> --out <pdf>` (el JSON es AnalysisResult serializado; también flag `--pdf` en scan opcional). El fallo del PDF NO altera el exit code del lint.
Desktop: botón 'Exportar PDF' en ResultsView que llame el comando save_pdf(result) (diálogo nativo + render).

Tests: pdf de ejemplo_codigo.txt → abrir/contar páginas (pdf-extract o verificación de bytes %PDF header) + total de hallazgos coincidente con el JSON; Unicode (í/á/é), paths largos, listas grandes (1000 hallazgos sintéticos).

agentActions: Generate a source-aware PDF from AnalysisResult without rerunning the engine.
Expose export from CLI and desktop only after text/JSON results are stable.
Test pagination, Unicode GeneXus text, long paths, and large finding lists.
acceptanceCriteria: PDF totals and diagnostics match the corresponding JSON result.
PDF failure does not alter the lint verdict or discard diagnostics.

stories.title: Align documentation, release helpers, and CI with actual delivery

handoffSpec.objective: Documentación y helpers verificados contra la entrega real.
steps: Auditar README/xtask: `cargo xtask build` está anunciado — verificar que xtask lo implementa (revisar crates/xtask/src/main.rs); si no, implementarlo (cargo build --release + copia de binarios) o quitar la mención.
Revisar plan/migration-rust.json: mantener como referencia histórica, agregar header 'superseded por plan/backlog-engine-cli-tauri.json (M0-M2 done)'.
PROGRESS.md: sección final de cierre con todas las adjudicaciones vigentes y el estado de las 20 historias.
